t: This is Barnes Cemetery, a disused burial ground off Rocks Lane on Barnes Common. Several notable people are buried here. Ebenezer Cobb Morley is regarded as one of the fathers of the Football Association and of modern football. Henry William Pickersgill was a portrait painter and a Royal Academician for almost fifty years. Francis Turner Palgrave was a poet and critic. James Heywood was a Member of Parliament who campaigned to open the universities to Dissenters. Augustus Mayhew, a journalist and writer, and the landscape painter George Augustus Williams also lie here.
